name: Toki no Kizuna Sekigahara Kitan
original_name: 十鬼の絆 関ヶ原奇譚
source:
It is the Warring States period in Japan. After the passing of Hideyoshi Toyotomi, many warlords started to watch for a chance to be the next ruler of the land. In the midst of time where history is changing with the upcoming battle of Sekigahara where the major daimyos split into Eastern and Western Armies, aiming to fight a decisive battle, there were demons who lived in the shadows of history, avoiding human involvement.

The protagonist is a member of the Ten-Demon Alliance, a coalition of demon clan chieftains. Her duty is to protect Princess Yase, leader of the Ten-Demon Alliance. One day, Princess Yase summons all the Ten-Demon Alliance chieftains across the land. [Spoiler]They are delighted at the reunion, but shortly after that, Princess Yase is attacked by forces unknowns. She is greatly weakened and falls into a deep sleep. The Ten-Demon Alliance chieftains, including the heroine, seek out the perpetrators who attacked the Princess. However, it becomes evident that within comrades which were believed to be tied with a strong bond, there were demons secretly in league with humans violating the commandment which all demons must obey.

The protagonist's mission: to find a way to rouse the Princess from her slumber, and
end demon interference with human affairs.[/spoiler]
This is the story of the demons who ran through the Warring States period, with the heroine having two missions in her mind.

[Taken from [url=https://shall-we-date.fandom.com/wiki/Demons%27_Bond]Demon's bond wiki]
translation:
日本正处于战国时代。丰臣秀吉去世后，众多大名开始伺机争夺天下。关原之战即将爆发，主要大名分裂为东西两军，历史正在转向新的方向；与此同时，还有一群避开人类、生活在历史阴影中的鬼族。

主人公是十鬼盟的一员——这是由鬼族首领组成的联盟。她的职责是保护十鬼盟首领八濑千羽。某天，八濑公主召集了遍布各地的十鬼盟首领。[Spoiler]众人因重逢而欣喜，可没过多久，八濑公主便遭到不明势力袭击。她身负重伤，陷入沉睡。包括女主角在内的十鬼盟首领开始追查袭击公主的幕后真凶。然而，他们逐渐发现，这些原本被认为情谊深厚的同伴之中，竟有鬼族暗中与人类勾结，违反了所有鬼族都必须遵守的戒律。

主人公的任务，是找到唤醒沉睡公主的方法，并终结鬼族干涉人类事务的行为。[/spoiler]

这是一群鬼族奔走于战国时代的故事，女主角心中始终肩负着两项使命。

[引自[url=https://shall-we-date.fandom.com/wiki/Demons%27_Bond]Demons' Bond维基]
